## Current state: public discussion open

Discussion is open in [RFC issue #261](https://github.com/licklider-ai/nomue-protocol/issues/261), following PR #260 opening-review GO and the maintainer's prior conditional opening instruction.

Opened: **2026-09-09T05:59:47Z**. Minimum window: **30 calendar days**, STABLE-INTENT. Earliest decision: **2026-10-09T05:59:47Z**; no automatic adoption.

The immutable discussion input remains `21453d82109106e9e811571383228dcef8f60fac`, candidate blob `807e4bf0c22e5270b8fc15824329d04b5c37b146`. Opening record and exact PR #260 review intake: `022c8699befbcba375e3aa6e07c1a8dd8eace483`. See `governance/drafts/release-4-preparation/public-discussion-opening-2026-09-09.md`.

Main was rechecked unchanged at `0abdca8f822d0de3faf35f218f762a951fd75e9e`. Numerical support remains NOT_ESTABLISHED and issuance HELD. The draft remains unmerged; opening does not adopt these proposed specifications or authorize supported execution.

Opening-record checks: Prettier, Markdown lint (409 files, zero issues after fixing a bare-URL formatting issue), typecheck, direct node/tsx validation, generated-drift (19 files) and diff check passed. Candidate and earlier evidence bytes are preserved. Earlier NOT_READY descriptions below are historical at their respective fixed inputs, not the current discussion state.

---

The bounded normal-model evidence is accepted, but opening preparation still needs concrete clause, identifier, surface, tier and compatibility choices that an independent reviewer can assess together.

This informative increment proposes those choices, records the Release 3 main-tree reconciliation, and separates numerical implementation holds from the opening decision. It updates navigation and supersession notices without changing any authoritative artifact, historical numerical input or accepted review.

The candidate proposes additive Record/payload/report schemas, explicit unissued Requirement IDs and HTTPS identifiers, unchanged strict-input/canonicalization guarantees, and a STABLE-INTENT highest tier with a minimum 30-day discussion window. These are review proposals; no identifiers, runtime support or discussion clock are issued.

Review input: `98187a14a48b38c9f2fb41fdd18060d53966a660`, tree `2f9286c107b64b59940269af98122d469639f0de`, parent `0abdca8f822d0de3faf35f218f762a951fd75e9e`.
Delivery: `6adfc8a0080e30ce7634a5912c4dbb32e97ecd17`, adding only the handoff and its README link.

Reviewer instructions: `governance/drafts/release-4-preparation/opening-rfc-review-handoff.md`. Review the whole assembled opening proposal and give separate R4-P1 through P6 and opening dispositions. Deliver a review-only draft PR against this branch.

Validation: repository-wide Prettier; Markdown lint (399 input / 400 delivery files, zero issues); typecheck; direct `node --import tsx tooling/src/validate.ts`; generated-drift check (19 files); diff check. Crosswalk IDs and owning documents match the registry; proposed numbered IDs are absent. Authoritative/numerical files are unchanged, so the full runtime/conformance suite was not rerun.

Authoring assistance: OpenAI Codex in the existing authoring context. This is not an independent review. Public opening remains NOT_READY pending independent assessment and resolution of decision-bearing findings.

---

## Response to PR 251 and PR 252

Both reports were read in full and preserved byte-for-byte under `review-inputs/r4-opening-rfc/PR-251-REVIEW.md` and `PR-252-REVIEW.md`; their original identical path would otherwise conflict. Original review commits and branches are retained. No steward acceptance or independent closure is inferred from intake.

Repaired input: `60a7caf05ebb4812e367a48c70621f092c26fedb`, tree `d21f634c7964581fad2bbc1f3bacc4b6eb4f8135`, sole parent `6adfc8a0080e30ce7634a5912c4dbb32e97ecd17`. Six input paths: candidate/README/readiness edits, response addition, and two exact review copies.

Confirmation delivery: `40e723d30c1e235591b0795d8c4535639ff4fc32`, adding only `opening-rfc-repair-confirmation.md` and its README link.

The response accounts for every PR 252 S-1–S-9/N-1–N-6 and PR 251 S-1/S-2/N-1/N-2. Repairs include authoritative meta-schema/version/fixture coupling; successor bindings and preserved check propagation; explicit declaration, number, zero-SSE and keyed report representation; envelope PCS-0001 reuse; lifecycle carrier and scoped reasons. Conflicting observations are reconciled against actual clause scope, especially the Welch-specific VERIFY-0020 rule. The new choices require confirmation; they are not already independently reviewed.

PR 251's structural counterexample reproduces four valid baselines, four rejected mutations and nine pattern errors, with identical output SHA-256. Input/delivery Markdown lint: 403/404 files, zero issues. Prettier, typecheck, direct node/tsx validation, generated-drift (19 files) and diff checks pass. Authoritative files, accepted source evidence, mathematical formula fence, numerical artifacts and Release 3 are preserved.

Next reviewer instructions: `governance/drafts/release-4-preparation/opening-rfc-repair-confirmation.md`. Public opening remains NOT_READY; proposed highest tier remains STABLE-INTENT / at least 30 days, subject to confirmation. No merge, ID issuance, runtime support or discussion clock.

---

## PR 257 boundary repair

The full review at `901733a551b560aef544191d937b517f2f87c896` is preserved at its original path with blob `d114c65903c97570dc157a5fc1a80314301134c5`.

C-S1: required references and identity/association rules now belong to semantic conformance. The report records structural/semantic violation stage, reason and path in conformance; all verification checks including integrity are gated on conformance pass. Well-formed false assertions, repeated units and unsupported counts remain distinct later admissibility failures. D1/D2 and related propagation fixtures are proposed explicitly.

C-N1: the non-numerical BTF admissibility carrier explicitly permits completed pass/fail only; completed indeterminate is invalid for that carrier, not coerced to ineligible. Other checks retain their own permitted outcomes. The new conditional report and lifecycle fixture obligations are stated.

Fixed repair input: `21453d82109106e9e811571383228dcef8f60fac`, tree `0194cdc31aa4e8463776cdb6d86863586d4981a3`, parent `40e723d30c1e235591b0795d8c4535639ff4fc32` (four paths). Delivery: `5b2adfb0e350a191a3c8b0d118db67242605ff0b`, adding only handoff and README link.

Next confirmation: `governance/drafts/release-4-preparation/opening-rfc-boundary-confirmation.md`. Both findings are AUTHOR_REPAIRED / CONFIRMATION_PENDING, not independently closed. Public opening remains NOT_READY.

Validation: Prettier, Markdown lint (406 input / 407 delivery files, zero issues), typecheck, direct node/tsx validate, generated-drift (19 files), diff check. Review blob and mathematical fence preserved; authoritative/numerical/Release 3 artifacts unchanged. No source acquisition, runtime adoption, merge or opening action.
